method: Vintage-correct rolling-origin validation with three-year forecast horizons.
overlapNote: Forecast windows overlap in calendar time and must not be treated as statistically independent experiments.

nationalAssumptionBenchmark.note: Compares each SCB national forecast vintage directly with realized Sweden births and deaths before local calibration.

fertilityLocalizationDiagnostic.note: Diagnostic only: compares current localized fertility with the same SCB national age-specific fertility profile applied without any local multiplier. It does not change the production baseline.

mortalityLocalizationDiagnostic.note: Diagnostic only: compares current localized mortality with the same SCB national age/sex mortality profile applied without any local multiplier. It does not change the production baseline.

ageCellWeightDiagnostic.note: Diagnostic only. Isolates the age-cell weighting choice while retaining the broad municipality factor. Compares 0% local age-cell weight, current information-weighted production values, and 100% local age-cell weight. This is distinct from the harder national-only diagnostic, which also removes the broad municipality factor.

definitions.zero: National age profile multiplied by the broad municipality factor; no one-year local cell deviation.
definitions.current: Production information-weighted blend between broad municipality factor and local one-year cell factor.
definitions.full: Local one-year cell factor at 100% weight, subject to the same fixed local/national ratio bounds.

localizationMethodDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic only. Compares the current production information weighting with a method-of-moments empirical-Bayes shrinkage candidate, a discrete second-difference penalized age smoother, and a natural cubic smoothing-spline candidate for fertility. The smoothing-spline candidate minimizes weighted squared deviations plus lambda times integrated squared curvature. Mortality also includes a separately locked SCB-inspired weighted-least-squares candidate: log(local hazard)=a+b*log(national hazard), fitted by geography/window/sex with observed local deaths as weights. Neither candidate claims to reproduce unpublished SCB optimization details. Lambda values are fixed sensitivity settings, not a promotion rule.

eventAgeTimingDiagnostic.note: Historical comparison of legacy V1 timing against the production event-age aligned cohort step. Primary evaluation horizon is n+1, secondary is n+2, and n+3 is supplementary robustness only.

migrationWindowDiagnostic.note: Migration-only comparison: fertility and mortality are fixed to the 10-year calibration while net migration uses 2, 3, 4, 6 or 10 years. n+1 is primary and n+2 secondary.

migrationAgeSmoothingDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic. Compares raw net10 age profile, existing adaptive local+national smoothing, and the pre-locked local+national+analogue smoothing. Analogue municipalities are re-ranked vintage-correctly at each origin.

requirements: n+1 population MAE not above raw net10
n+1 net migration MAE not above raw net10
at least one n+1 metric strictly below raw net10
n+2 population MAE not above raw net10
n+2 net migration MAE not above raw net10
existingGate.note: Existing local+national adaptive smoothing must pass this gate before it can advance beyond diagnostic status.

requiredBeforePromotion: n+1 population MAE not worse than existing local+national smoothing or raw net10
n+1 net migration MAE not worse than existing local+national smoothing or raw net10
at least one n+1 metric strictly better than both comparators
n+2 population MAE not worse than existing local+national smoothing or raw net10
n+2 net migration MAE not worse than existing local+national smoothing or raw net10

backtestSelection.method: rerank candidate pool at each rolling origin using only years available through that origin
backtestSelection.note: The current 2015-2024 top five is descriptive for the 2025 model only and is not retroactively imposed on historical origins.

structuralTarget.analogueAggregation: similarity-score-weighted age/sex shares among the origin-specific top five
structuralTarget.formula: adjacent Lulea local-age mean + 0.5*Sweden age curvature + 0.5*analogue-pool age curvature
structuralTarget.retentionRule: same information+persistence local-retention rule as the existing adaptive smoothing candidate
structuralTarget.totalPreservation: smooth gross in and gross out age/sex shares separately, renormalize each to 1, then multiply by the original Lulea gross in/out annual totals; net profile = smoothed gross in - smoothed gross out
structuralTarget.governance: Weights and formula are fixed before rolling-origin forecast outcomes are generated.

candidate.note: Analogue top-five is re-ranked at each origin using only information available through that origin.

migrationSplineDiagnostic.note: New development candidate, separate from the previously rejected adaptive migration_age_smoothing. Smooths only the one-year-age distribution of the 10-year net-migration profile with a natural cubic spline at locked lambda=10, while preserving the annual net-migration total separately for each municipality and sex. Production baseline is unchanged.

componentFlowDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic only. Compares the locked three-leg component_flow engine with the existing 10-year exogenous net-migration baseline inside the full cohort model. The component windows were selected using Lulea development data, so this is not independent holdout evidence.

candidate.selectionSample: Lulea municipality component results used to choose windows after #37
candidate.note: This rolling comparison is a development diagnostic, not independent confirmation.

componentRecencyDiagnostic.note: Stage-1 development diagnostic. Uses the locked component_flow engine but replaces only rest-of-Sweden out-migration hazards with the pre-declared adaptive recency rule selected after #53. Not independent evidence.

candidate.note: Selected from Lulea migration diagnostics after #53; full cohort rolling-origin is stage 1.

scbRiskFlowDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic only. Compares a method locked from SCB regional projection documentation with the existing 10-year exogenous net-migration baseline. Domestic inflow is risk-based on the rest of Sweden, outflows are municipal risks, and immigration follows the municipality share of projected national immigration.

candidate.methodBasis: Published SCB regional projection method; locked before this candidate is evaluated.
candidate.note: Lulea rolling-origin results are development diagnostics. Previously viewed municipalities are not independent confirmation.

profetBirthStatusDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic only. Adds Swedish-born/foreign-born population state and migration risks to the Profet-like risk engine while keeping fertility and mortality unchanged.

candidate.methodBasis: Published SCB regional state dimension: single-year age x sex x Swedish-/foreign-born.

requirements: n+1 population MAE strictly below net10
n+1 net migration MAE strictly below net10
n+2 population MAE not above net10
n+2 net migration MAE not above net10
promotionGate.note: Locked before rolling-origin results are generated. External validation is still required before level 4.

candidate.note: This stage isolates birth-status migration/state effects; fertility and mortality are unchanged.

birthStatusNet10ConstrainedDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic only. Preserves the production net10 migration total by sex and one-year age and allocates it between Swedish-born and foreign-born states using locked 10-year gross-flow shares. Compared with a locked stock-share allocation using the same net10 total.

candidate.note: Preserves net10 totals exactly and evaluates only Swedish-/foreign-born composition. 2018-2024 is development evidence only.

structuralGate.rule: Aggregate population and net migration must match net10 baseline by year.

developmentGate.rule: Historical-flow allocation must beat stock-share allocation for both pooled birth-status MAEs while preserving net10 totals.

profetConsistencyDiagnostic.note: Development diagnostic only. Compares the same Profet birth-status engine with and without the locked Norrbotten municipality-to-county consistency layer. Only origins with same-vintage frozen county targets are scored.

requirements: n+1 population MAE not above unadjusted Profet
n+1 net migration MAE not above unadjusted Profet
at least one n+1 MAE strictly below unadjusted Profet
n+2 population MAE not above unadjusted Profet
n+2 net migration MAE not above unadjusted Profet
promotionGate.note: This gate decides whether the municipality-to-county layer advances inside the Profet development candidate. It does not promote the component to production level 4.

candidate.note: Uses frozen same-vintage SCB county flow targets and all 14 Norrbotten municipalities. Production net10 remains unchanged.
